subject: general
question: Most of the Thar desert lies within India, spanning the states of _________

options.text: Rajasthan, Gujarat, Punjab, and Uttar Pradesh
Rajasthan, Gujarat, Punjab, and Madhya Pradesh
Rajasthan, Gujarat, Punjab, and Himachal Pradesh

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2: Rajasthan, Gujarat, Punjab, and Haryana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Thar Desert, also known as the Great Indian Desert, is predominantly located in the northwestern region of India.
 
• It spans across the Indian states of Rajasthan, Gujarat, Punjab, and Haryana, making it a significant geographical feature in these areas.
 
• The desert covers approximately 77,000 square miles (200,000 square kilometers), with Rajasthan accounting for the majority of its land area.
 
• It is characterized by arid conditions, sand dunes, sparse vegetation, and extreme temperatures, making it one of the most inhospitable regions in India.
 
• The Thar Desert also extends into Pakistan, but the majority of its area lies within Indian territory.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Climate of the Thar Desert:**

 
 
• The Thar Desert experiences an arid climate with very low rainfall, typically less than 200mm annually.
 
• Temperatures can soar above 50°C in the summer and drop below freezing in the winter.
 
 
 
• **Ecological Significance:**
 
 
• The desert hosts unique flora and fauna adapted to its harsh conditions, including desert foxes, camels, and khejri trees.
 
• The Desert National Park located in Rajasthan is a protected area that showcases the biodiversity of the region.
 
 
 
• **Human Settlement:**
 
 
• The Thar Desert is one of the world's most densely populated deserts, with villages scattered across its landscape.
 
• Traditional occupations in the region include camel breeding, agriculture (using irrigation), and handicrafts.
 
 
 
• **Geographical Features:**
 
 
• Sand dunes, salt pans, and rocky outcrops are prominent features of the Thar Desert's terrain.
 
• The Luni River is the only major river flowing through the desert region.
